title: Calibrate negative Lightroom Dehaze imports
notes: Provisional: RAW Lightroom sidecars now import negative Dehaze at 0.125 strength, calibrated on two effective night photos with Dehaze -15 and -23; values beyond -23 are extrapolated. Zeroing was nearly as good (mean-luma error 3.224 versus 3.474), and the original-night black fraction remains far off (3.560% versus Lightroom 11.655%). The third photo was a positive-Dehaze unchanged control, not a calibration point. Clarity, Texture, positive Dehaze, rendered sources, and default renders are unchanged. Reusable .xmp presets applied to RAW and mask-local LocalDehaze remain unscaled exceptions.
